tools.plan.description: Submit a persistent plan covering the next several turns of economy, military, intelligence and diplomacy: goals, priorities, resource constraints and adjustment conditions, grounded in facts. Not a log of this turn. Revise when it expires or the strategy changes; no need to resubmit a valid plan.
tools.end_turn.description: End this nation's actions. summary must be one or two sentences on what was actually done this turn and key pending items; detailed actions already have receipts. Do not repeat the plan, per-tile lists or next-turn strategy. A valid plan is required. Unanswered offers are rejected and open votes are voted against automatically.
tools.government.description: Show this nation's valid plan, expiry, ended state and turn summaries; no arguments.

tool.end_turn.auto_votes: End of turn: unanswered votes {ids} automatically voted against.
tools.explain_plan.description: Explain the rejected plan and how it will be corrected. After explaining, actions can end this turn; an explanation does not replace a new plan or trigger another review this turn.
tools.recruit.description: Recruit at a site in this nation (site is a place name or "x y" string, or pass integers x and y); returns the actual cost and unit IDs. New units cannot act this turn; barracks and energy requirements are rules, while unit costs, caps and speed are in unit_catalog.
tools.move.description: Move this nation's units to one target tile: place is a name or "x y" string, or pass integers x and y. Movement does not occupy land. New, moved or engaged units cannot move normally; movement, attacks elsewhere and retreats share the action budget. Attack is required for foreign territory; routes obey terrain and unit speed. Unit selection is id (single positive integer) or ids (nonempty unique positive integers); id also accepts an array and ids a single value; they conflict only when they point at different units. Batch actions validate the whole batch; batch reachability groups results by unit number.
tools.attack.description: Attack one target tile with this nation's units (place is a name or "x y" string, or integers x and y); all must be reachable and have action budget. An undefended tile is occupied; defenders start a battle resolved at settlement; submission is not a result. Foreign nations require an effective war. New units cannot attack; attacking in place keeps movement budget. Unit selection is id or ids; id also accepts an array and ids a single value; they conflict only when they point at different units; batch actions validate the whole batch; batch reachability groups by unit number.
tools.retreat.description: Retreat engaged units by id to an adjacent legal tile (place is a name or "x y" string, or integers x and y), sharing the movement budget. They still fight this turn and leave after settlement; retreat lowers output, defender retreat reduces damage taken. Unit selection is id or ids; id also accepts an array and ids a single value; they conflict only when they point at different units; batch actions validate the whole batch; batch reachability groups by unit number.
tools.disband.description: Disband this nation's units for free, by id or ids; engaged units cannot disband. Maintenance stops and slots are released immediately; no food, equipment or gold is returned. Unit selection is id or ids; id also accepts an array and ids a single value; they conflict only when they point at different units; batch actions validate the whole batch; batch reachability groups by unit number.
tools.army.description: List this nation's units and all visible units: nation, integer id, kind, position, HP and action/engagement/retreat state; no coordinates. Unit ids are per nation.
tools.reachable.description: For each of this nation's units, list visible legal move destinations and path costs; attack=true includes attack reach. Unit ids only, no target coordinates, no fog paths. Unit selection is id or ids; id also accepts an array and ids a single value; they conflict only when they point at different units; batch actions validate the whole batch; batch reachability groups by unit number.
tools.frontier.description: Count visible unowned tiles nationwide, per-unit reachable counts (units), the union of destinations and expansion targets; no coordinates.
tools.logistics.description: Military requirements: per-unit supply, camp exemptions, starvation damage, healing equipment required/used and expected HP recovery, followed by supply and equipment totals, stocks and shortages. Militia healing costs no equipment. Read-only current-stock forecast; excludes subsequent production and actions.
tools.unit_catalog.description: All unit types: recruitment resources, full HP, attack, speed, terrain movement cost and supply under national policy. Includes healing cap and equipment rule per type: each equipment supplies 30 total HP, shared equally among eligible regular wounded units; militia heals free.
tools.threats.description: All other nations' units in view and current relations, excluding this nation and barbarians; no coordinates.
tools.battle.description: All visible or own-participating battles: sides, per-kind counts, base output, terrain/castle reduction and retreat. Blind battles show only own units and do not leak enemies; not a per-target forecast.
tools.tile.description: The only per-tile query: place is a name or "x y" string, or integers x and y; returns visible details (named tiles show their name, unowned tiles only coordinates). Own and materialized unowned sites show resources, capacity, construction and buildings; foreign tiles show only terrain, owner, public castles/town halls and visible units. Fog cannot be queried.

tools.economy.description: Economy commands: choose the action with action; the remaining arguments depend on it. Prices are in query(panel=market); stocks and reports in query(panel=econ/report).

tools.military.parameters.properties.act:
recruit: recruit at a home site; site is a place name or "x y" string, or pass integers x and y. kind and count are optional.
move (requires id or ids): move units to one target tile; place is a name or "x y" string, or integers x and y.
attack (requires id or ids): attack one target tile with units; place is a name or "x y" string, or integers x and y.
retreat (requires id or ids): retreat engaged units to an adjacent legal tile; place is a name or "x y" string, or integers x and y.
disband (requires id or ids): disband units for free; engaged units cannot disband.
tools.economy.parameters.properties.acti:
buy (requires resource, quantity): buy a positive quantity from the market; returns the actual payment and fill.
sell (requires resource, quantity): sell a positive quantity you hold; returns the actual proceeds.
borrow: borrow the fixed credit line (latest settled GDP×5) for five turns at the savings rate plus 2%; the amount cannot be chosen.
buy_report (requires target): pay {report_fee} gold for another nation's published economic report, delivered immediately: GDP and growth, investment, recruitment, military use, assets, debt and trade. turn defaults to the latest published period. This is dated economic evidence, not current troop positions or complete military strength; use spy or other intelligence for those.
tools.relations.parameters.properties.ac:
guarantee (requires target): we are the guarantor and target is the protected entity; if a third party declares war on target, we must defend. This does not make target defend us or support our attacks. Both sides must be at peace and an alliance votes first.
cancel_guarantee (requires target): cancel your guarantee; treaties are frozen during war.
propose_defense (requires target): offer a mutual-defense pact; acceptance is required and an alliance votes first.
break_defense (requires target): break a mutual-defense pact; not during war.
accept_proposal (requires offer): accept a mutual-defense or founding offer from query(panel=foreign).
reject_proposal (requires offer): reject a mutual-defense or founding offer.
bloc_found (requires bloc, name, tos): invite independent, peaceful nations to found an alliance; bloc is a unique namespace key, tos is an array of other nation ids.
bloc_join (requires bloc): apply to join an existing alliance; current members vote.
bloc_leave: leave the current alliance; forbidden while any member is at war and the chief must transfer or dissolve first.
bloc_dissolve: the chief dissolves a peacetime alliance.
bloc_transfer (requires target): the chief hands leadership to another member.
bloc_rename (requires name): the chief renames the alliance.
declare_war (requires target): declare war on another diplomatic entity; truces block this and your alliance votes first.
offer_peace (requires target, kind): offer peace to the enemy war representative; kind=white/pay/demand, gold>0 for pay or demand, truce is the truce length.
accept_peace (requires offer): accept a peace offer from query(panel=foreign).
reject_peace (requires offer): reject a peace offer; the war continues.
vote (requires vote, accept): vote on an open vote; accept=true for yes, false for no, null to abstain; unvoted votes count as no when the turn ends.
tools.intelligence.parameters.properties:
send_letter (requires target, text): send a letter to another nation; charged on submission and delivered at settlement.
gift (requires target, resource, quantity): gift a positive quantity of a resource; delivered next period.
share_map (requires target): send your visible map; the recipient sees dated intelligence next period.
spy (requires target): pay {spy_fee} gold; dated national stocks, known map, diplomacy and unit counts arrive in intel after {spy_delay} periods. No unit positions or ids.

llm.system: You are a nation player in Zhanguo. Act only through the supplied player tools. Use namespaced content IDs and zero-based coordinates. State is filtered by your permissions. Consult player_rules for rules. Current state is supplied in full at the start of each turn; nothing is appended between batches, so query the specific tool for the latest state. A submitted diplomatic request awaits settlement; it is not an effective treaty. Publish a valid plan, then call end_turn with an action summary. Prefer x/y coordinates for site operations, and integer army id for id/ids. Each army fact pairs this nation's id with its kind; id/ids must reference that record's id. IDs are nation-local, so do not assume a fixed unit kind for IDs such as 1 or 2. position is [x,y]; stocks maps resource IDs to amounts. query(panel=map) returns structured rows with position/name/terrain/owner/buildings; owner=null is unowned and has no public name. query(panel=tile) gives one tile in full, query(panel=land) your own. For build/recruit/move/attack/retreat, site and place are interchangeable names for a location name or coordinate string. If both are supplied, they must identify the same tile. Alternatively use integer x and y without a location reference. Army tools move/attack/retreat/disband and query(panel=reachable) accept id for one unit or ids for a batch; when both are supplied they must agree. Movement, attack and retreat validate the entire batch first. Multi-unit reachable results are grouped by unit number. Ending your turn automatically rejects unanswered received diplomatic offers at no charge and casts no votes for open unanswered alliance ballots. Explicit replies and abstentions are preserved; newly sent offers await the recipient's next action turn.
llm.continue: Continue using tools; this turn requires a valid plan and end_turn.
